Chamber-style handoff review for DeepSeek Harness: linked read-only review sessions, round by round.
# dsh-handoff-review

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that hands the
current session's changes to a linked, **read-only review s

ession** — a
round-by-round handoff review in the spirit of OpenChamber.

The implementation session keeps working; an ordinary review session in the same
workspace reviews t

he change in an independent context. Its report can be sent
back to the implementer, later revisions

can be sent back to the reviewer, and
every round is kept in a durable link record. The plugin only

adds commands,
routes, projections, listeners and UI slots: nothing is written into the DSH
kernel,
and removing the bundle removes everything it registered.

**交接續作 / handoff continuation** is the other direction: a compact `交接`
button in the composer turns

the current session into a deterministic handoff
prompt for a **new ordinary session** in the same w

orkspace, so long-running work
can continue in a fresh context. The existing review flow is unchange

d; the
continuation surface is purely additive (new routes, slot registrations and
locale keys only)

; the
continuation surface is purely additive (new routes, slot registrations and
locale keys only).

*Link state, both sessions, actions and round history in the right-sidebar
panel (session and link i

both sessions, actions and round history in the right-sidebar
panel (session and link ids masked).*
*Reviewer route and handoff limits under Settings → Handoff Review.*
## Features

- **One command to start.** `/handoff-review focus on retry logic` (or the
composer dock button) cre

ates or reuses a link, opens a review session and
delivers a handoff brief: goal, review focus, chan

ged files, unified diff,
verification and open questions.
- **Read-only reviewer.** Three independen

t layers: a durable
`sandbox/mode: read-only` session event, removal/denial of write tools on the
re

viewer's scoped tool runtime, and an `approval: never` policy.
- **Round loop.** Send the reviewer's

report back to the implementation session;
after the fixes, send only the changes after the last ha

ndoff watermark as
round + 1. `maxRounds`, per-round dedupe and a delivery rate limit keep the
loop

s
round + 1. `maxRounds`, per-round dedupe and a delivery rate limit keep the
loop bounded.
[该节后续省略]
## Requirements

- DSH Desktop (`0.2.x`), **or** a matching `dsh` CLI serving the Web GUI with
`dsh web` (`0.2.x`). B

oth GUIs use the same Web client and the same
per-profile **Plugins** page. The profile must be base

-backed and provide
`ctx.storageDomain` (the shipped `desktop` and `web` profiles do).
- Node.js >=

20 for development and tests only; a built checkout needs no build
step.
## Security

- The reviewer cannot modify files (sandbox mode, tool guard, approval policy).
- Reviewer reports a

re untrusted data: every cross-session message starts with
`[handoff-review] …` and marks itself as

data, not instructions.
- Credential-looking diff lines (`*_KEY`, `*_TOKEN`, `password`, `secret`,
`

api[_-]?key`) are redacted and `.env`-like files are skipped. A diff can still
contain sensitive mat

erial — treat handoffs like patches.
- `/handoff-review/api/*` are exact web-server routes and apply

the host
browser-trust fence themselves; no approval escalation is performed.
- Continuation requir

es a **live source session** (`NO_IMPL_AGENT` otherwise) and
never writes into it. The new session i

s ordinary and writable: no reviewer
sandbox, approval policy or tool restrictions are applied, and

no link/round
record is stored — the handoff is just its first user message.
- The continuation prev

iew may make **one optional LLM summary call** on the
source agent's own provider/model route (15 s

bound). Any missing service,
timeout, error or empty output falls back to a deterministic summary an

d is
reported as a warning, so the preview still succeeds.
- The continuation prompt is built with t

he same secret redaction and diff caps as
review handoffs; the base prompt is capped by `maxHandoffC

hars` and the user
supplement is separately capped at 4000 characters and appended after the cap.
-

Continuation drafts live in Host memory only: 15-minute TTL, one live draft per
source session, at m

ost eight retained. A draft is consumed by a successful start,
and also by a failed start that alrea

dy created a session (an error carrying a
session id, e.g. `NO_CONTINUATION_AGENT` or a delivery fai

lure); it is retained
only for failures before session creation so a retry can reuse it. A post-crea

te
failure keeps the modal on the created session id with **Open session** and no
Retry, so the auto

matic path cannot create a duplicate (a fresh manual `交接`
starts a new preview and may create anothe

r session by design). A Host restart
invalidates the draft and the modal's Retry rebuilds the previe

y design). A Host restart
invalidates the draft and the modal's Retry rebuilds the preview.
[该节后续省略]
## Status and limitations

- A review session cannot create another link, so review-of-review chains are
intentionally blocked.

- No cross-machine sync/relay; no Review button inside the official diff card
(no public slot — the

standalone diff drawer is used instead).
- Handoff continuation needs the source session to be open

and live; a cold
session must be opened first (`NO_IMPL_AGENT`).
- Continuation drafts are in-memor

y: restarting DSH invalidates an open preview
(`DRAFT_EXPIRED`, retry from the modal). The new sessi

on is never a review
session and no link/history is kept for it.
- Optional Host services degrade to

warnings rather than failures: without a
readable model catalog the provider/model selectors are di

sabled and the effort
selector only offers the model default (a legacy preview payload that has no
`

catalog` field can still carry flat `efforts`); providers that fail to list are
named in a hint. Wit

hout `sessionTitle` the new session is left untitled,
without a resolved workspace it is not attache

d to the sidebar, and without an
LLM the summary is deterministic.
- Applying the chosen continuatio

n model/thinking effort calls
`sessionController.selectModel`. The DSH kernel also persists that sel

ection as
the **deployment default model/effort** (the same mechanism the review settings
already us

e; unavoidable through the public API).
- The existing review flow is unchanged: continuation adds r

outes, prompts, slot
registrations and locale keys only.
- The UI is localized (en / zh-TW); Host-si

de command receipts and route errors
are Traditional Chinese only.
